# Pull request

## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] App compatibility improvement
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / packaging
- [ ] Refactor

## Testing

Describe what you tested.

- [ ] Built successfully on Windows
- [ ] Tested close button
- [ ] Tested minimize button
- [ ] Tested maximize/restore button
- [ ] Tested dragging a window
- [ ] Tested with at least two visible windows
- [ ] Tested with a custom-titlebar app if relevant

## Safety checklist

- [ ] This change does not patch `System32`.
- [ ] This change does not patch `uxtheme.dll`.
- [ ] This change does not replace Explorer or DWM.
- [ ] This change does not inject DLLs into other apps.
- [ ] This change does not require administrator access for normal use.
- [ ] This change remains reversible by exiting MacTrafficLights.

## Screenshots

If the change affects visuals, add screenshots or a short screen recording.
